captions.detailed: This object is a bridge-supported cantilever arm mechanism. It features a dark grey, rectangular frame structure serving as a grounded base, which supports a long, light grey upper link extending forward. This is followed by a shorter light grey forelink and a small dark grey wrist plate at the tip. The assembly is articulated by three revolute joints enabling shoulder, elbow, and wrist rotations.
captions.instruction: Generate a bridge-supported cantilever arm as an articulated assembly in CadQuery. The model should feature a grounded dark grey base frame, a long light grey upper link, a shorter light grey forelink, and a small dark grey wrist plate, all connected sequentially by three revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct a grounded base frame using box primitives arranged into a vertical rectangular frame with a horizontal cross-brace and a solid bottom plate. Create the upper link as a long, thin horizontal box with a small connection block at one end. Model the forelink similarly but shorter, and the wrist plate as a small rectangular block. Define three revolute joints (shoulder, elbow, and wrist) with rotation axes oriented to allow vertical or horizontal articulation of the links relative to the base.
